The main takeaway from our work is that

, in the context of deep RL, regularization and representation learning can improve the generalization and sample efficiency of DQNs, but that these improvements are not as significant as in supervised learning.

, by using traditional regularization methods, we can improve generalization in deep Q-learning, and that this improvement is not only in terms of performance, but also in terms of the quality of the learned features.

DQN, as it is, is not an ideal algorithm to learn robust representations that generalize across tasks, and that it is possible to improve generalization by applying standard regularization techniques from supervised learning to the DQN algorithm.
